landing.pill: Fast answers and agents, on your own infrastructure
landing.headline2: Get answers, or get it done.
landing.sub: One platform with two modes. Fast answers with sources you can check. Agent mode plans, uses your tools and asks before it acts. An automatic router chooses for each question.
landing.flowAria: A question goes to the router, then either the fast lane (hybrid search, rerank, generate) or the agent lane (plan, MCP tools, approval), and both end in an answer with citations
landing.flowAgent: AGENT · plans, calls tools, asks first

guarantees.label: every fact links to its source
data stays on your infrastructure by default
API keys ever shown in the UI

landing.featuresLead: Every step is configured in the admin console, with no code changes.

router.title: Two modes, one smart router
router.body: Simple lookups go to fast answers. Tasks that need tools go to the agent. You set the confidence threshold and the fallback.

flow.title: Visual pipeline builder
flow.body: Ingestion, retrieval, reranking, generation and guardrails, each step configured per chatbot.

bots.title: Many chatbots, scoped access
bots.body: HR, IT, Legal and more. Each bot has its own knowledge, pipeline and groups, so people only see their bots.

providers.title: Modular providers and BYOK
providers.body: Swap LLM, embeddings, reranker, vector store or parser. Local or external. Keys live in OpenBao, write-only.

tools.title: Tools through MCP
tools.body: Connect tickets, calendars, HR systems and databases as MCP servers, with per-tool permissions.

automations.title: Automations and approvals
automations.body: Scheduled and event-driven agents that draft, check and act, and wait for a person when it matters.

health.title: Knowledge health
health.body: Spots stale, conflicting and missing documents, and the questions your knowledge can't answer yet.

channels.title: Wherever people work
channels.body: Web app, mobile, Microsoft Teams, Slack and a REST API, all with the same permissions and sources.

eval.title: Evaluate before you ship
eval.body: Ragas scores on every pipeline version, traces in Langfuse, and a one-click rollback when quality drops.
eval.gateNote: A version that scores below the gate cannot be published.
